item.title: Brendan Fraser sings the praises of his "Rental Family" co-star as the film heads to Hulu
item.description: Brendan Fraser, Shannon Gorman and director Hikari talk about family, filming and feelings of human connection in "Rental Family," which comes to Hulu and Hulu on Disney+ Feb. 18.

item.title: FEMA working with Harris County Flood Control District on new map
item.description: For the first time in nearly two decades, FEMA is getting ready to finalize a new flood map, reflecting the growing risk of extreme flood events in Harris County.

item.title: More than 87,000 applications for school voucher program sent in, state officials say
item.description: Texas launched its $1 billion school voucher program one week ago, and thousands of families across the state have raced to apply.

item.title: Nat Geo's new documentary, 'Ghost Elephants,' follows the journey to find these elusive animals
item.description: National Geographic's new documentary film, "Ghost Elephants," follows explorer Steve Boyes' journey to locating the largest land mammals ever recorded.

item.title: 'Dawson's Creek' star James Van Der Beek dies at age 48
item.description: James Van Der Beek, the actor known for his roles in "Dawson's Creek," "Varsity Blues" and "The Rules of Attraction," has died. He was 48.

item.title: Ponoma Elementary student dead after choking on food, according to Alvin ISD
item.description: A Ponoma Elementary school student has died after choking on food, according to Alvin ISD.

item.title: Houston-area gun shop warns customers about follow-home robberies
item.description: The story of a man who was followed home from the gun range and robbed should serve as a cautionary tale, one local gun store owner says.

item.title: Family says teen handcuffed at Rockets game after being wrongfully accused of theft
item.description: What was meant to be a fun night for a father and son at a Houston Rockets game ended with the teen detained after his dad says he was wrongfully accused of stealing from the team store.

item.title: Instagram chief says he does not believe people can get clinically addicted to social media
item.description: Adam Mosseri, the head of Meta's Instagram, testified Wednesday during a landmark social media trial that he disagrees with the idea that people can be clinically addicted to social media platforms.

item.title: Bud Cort, best known for role in 'Harold and Maude,' dies at 77
item.description: Actor Bud Cort, best known for his role in the 1971 film "Harold and Maude," has died. He was 77.
